verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments API platform, a type of product that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack mentions only SDKs, prebuilt UIs, plugins, a Postman collection and dashboard features. None of these is an official command-line tool, and the Postman collection and SDKs are adjacent developer building blocks rather than a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
